eas_text: A civil authority has issued AN IMMEDIATE EVACUATION NOTICE for the following counties or areas: Hot Springs, WY; at 5:31 PM on AUG 16, 2025 Effective until 9:31 PM. Message from WSLF/CAP.
extra_text: Fire Evacuation immediately East of Jones Creek Road at Buffalo Creek Road, South to the Fremont County line and East to the Washakie County Line.
